endpoint_order: 3 cyclic rotations repeated four cycles; alternate cycles reversed
direct_cli: hook-post-tool; FutureEvent is payload only, host dispatcher unverified

contract.unknown-event: each worker exit0 and empty stdout
contract.missing-scanner-open: new valid session per batch; exactly one warning envelope and stderr notice; remaining concurrency-1 stdout empty; all worker exit0; warmup and regular same contract
contract.missing-scanner-closed: all worker exit2, empty stdout, explicit closed stderr; batch exit1 expected

retained_home: each measurement/version/mode/concurrency retains HOME for audit cache; each batch gets a new session id
single_measurement: same outer batch shell as four concurrency; includes wrapper overhead in all versions
